title: Grandma Gone Wild! Neighbor From Hell Causes Havoc!
description:
On September 11th, 2022, Rio Rancho Police Department responded to an incident of a woman who claimed her neighbor used a garden hose to spray her with water twice. 

Officers spoke with the woman who stated she went to check her A/C unit on the side of her property when her neighbor started a fight and sprayed her with water twice. At the time of speaking with the woman, she stated the incident had happened 15 minutes earlier. Officers also noted her clothes were dry and that there was no water near the A/C unit in question.

Upon speaking to the other neighbor in question they learned that they were in their backyard, with young children present, when the woman came looking over the fence and began cursing and shouting racial slurs. They asked her to stop and leave before going inside their house. It was not the first instance of the woman trying to start fights on their property.

After speaking with both parties and reviewing the evidence the woman was charged with Disorderly Conduct. She was issued a court summons that same day related to the charge.
